{{Quote|It was the most awful thing I've ever seen. Theta storms kill in two ways, you see. If you're contaminated from a distance, well, it takes a long time to die. A '''theta storm''' was a sunspot activity that agitated radioactive theta particles in a [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].
